intermediate_run.explanation: Started before the final per-device logout fix. Had 47 unchanged bank failures and the now-fixed JTI race failure. Superseded by complete final rerun, not combined with it.

tooling_notes: Browser harness selectors were corrected (implicit text input type, duplicate Users buttons); these were harness failures, not product fixes.
Initial Chromium launch lacked libnspr4. Bundled al2023 libraries supplied through LD_LIBRARY_PATH; web security was not disabled.
Screenshot timeout resolved with animations disabled and larger timeout.
Initial standalone restart-login request lacked Origin and correctly received bad_origin; rerun with same-origin header passed.
scope_limitations: Static 14-module/366-declaration inventory and 18-tab render smoke are not exhaustive operation/form coverage.
Injected file-rename failure/reload tests are not power-loss, fsync or multiwriter certification.
No external AI network/model tests or paid fallback.
